terrain.name: Cosmic River of Time Temporal Flow

regions.name: Eastern Sea
regions.notes: Abundant maritime realm with the richest natural immortal materials and decentralized super forces.

regions.name: Northern Plains
regions.notes: Nomadic plains dominated by Huang Jin bloodline tribes and the legacy of Giant Sun Immortal Venerable.

regions.name: Western Desert
regions.notes: Vast desert expanse dotted with oases and merchant clans governed by ancient fire and sand paths.

regions.name: Central Continent
regions.notes: Dominant sect-based heartland governed under Heavenly Court's supreme 3-million-year authority.

regions.name: Southern Border
regions.notes: Home of karst spires, dense vegetation, and fiercely independent clan strongholds.

regions.name: Immemorial Two Heavens
regions.notes: Remnants of the ancient Nine Heavens: White Heaven and Black Heaven sheltering immemorial desolate beasts.

regions.name: Cosmic River of Time
regions.notes: The metaphysical river regulating past, present, and future, navigable via Spring Autumn Cicada.

locations.name: Qing Mao Mountain
locations.description: Cradle of Gu Yue Village, Xiong Clan, and Bai Clan; scene of Spring Autumn Cicada rebirth.

locations.name: Gu Yue Village
locations.description: The ancestral moonlight pavilion and academy where Fang Yuan awakened his Rank 1 C-grade aperture.

locations.name: Bai Gu Mountain
locations.description: Bone-laden mountain range holding Grey Bone Scholar's inheritance and Flesh-Bone Unity Gu.

locations.name: Shang Clan City
locations.description: Grand trading capital of Southern Border, fortified with ancient earth path formations and 5 battle arenas.

locations.name: San Cha Mountain
locations.description: Site of Three Kings Blessed Land (King Bao, King Kuang, King Xin) and the rebirth of Fixed Immortal Travel.

locations.name: Yi Tian Mountain
locations.description: Epic battleground of the Righteous vs Demonic war; refinement crucible of Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu.

locations.name: Wu Mountain
locations.description: Headquarters of Wu Clan, the preeminent super clan of Southern Border led by Wu Du Xiu and Wu Yong.

locations.name: Crescent Lake
locations.description: Gathering ground for the Heroes Assembly where Wolf King Chang Shan Yin re-emerged into mortal politics.

locations.name: Eighty-Eight True Yang Building
locations.description: Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's Rank 8 Immortal Gu House, looting Northern Plains resources for millennia.

locations.name: Imperial Court Blessed Land
locations.description: Sanctuary blessed land opened every ten years for the victors of the Northern Plains war.

locations.name: Lang Ya Blessed Land
locations.description: Refinement path blessed land of Long Hair Ancestor, home of the hairy men and countless Immortal Gu recipes.

locations.name: Crazed Demon Cave
locations.description: Nine-layered subterranean rift created by Limitless Demon Venerable to deduce eternal life.

locations.name: Heavenly Court
locations.description: The supreme holy land of humanity, housing Fate Gu, Primordial Origin's legacy, and Duke Long.

locations.name: Hu Immortal Blessed Land
locations.description: Blessed land anchored on Tian Ti Mountain; home to Dang Hun Mountain and guts Gu production.

locations.name: Spirit Affinity House
locations.description: One of Central Continent's Ten Great Ancient Sects, sect of Feng Jiu Ge and Feng Jin Huang.

locations.name: Reverse Flow River
locations.description: Secluded Domain of Heaven and Earth where perseverance overcomes all; birthplace of Reverse Flow Protection Seal.

locations.name: River of Time Nexus
locations.description: Universal torrent of time carrying past, present, and future, protected by Time Dao killer moves.

locations.name: Stone Lotus Island
locations.description: Time-suspended island sanctuary left behind by Red Lotus Demon Venerable to shatter Fate Gu.

events.name: Qing Mao Mountain Bloodbath
events.description: Fang Yuan sacrifices the Gu Yue clan with Blood Skull Gu and consumes ancestors to ascend to Rank 3.

events.name: Three Kings Blessed Land Reversal
events.description: Betrayed by Bai Ning Bing at the brink of death, Fang Yuan detonates Spring Autumn Cicada to rewind time.

events.name: Collapse of Eighty-Eight True Yang Building
events.description: Fang Yuan shatters the Rank 8 Immortal Gu House, becoming an Immortal Zombie and escaping Heavenly Court's encirclement.

events.name: Battle of Yi Tian Mountain
events.description: Spectral Soul refines Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu; Fang Yuan intercepts fate and snatches the Rank 9 body.

events.name: Reverse Flow River Perseverance
events.description: Fang Yuan marches upstream through Reverse Flow River, stunning both immortals and creating Reverse Flow Protection Seal.

events.name: Destruction of Fate Gu
events.description: Fang Yuan and three regions allies breach Heavenly Court, culminating in the permanent destruction of Fate Gu.

events.name: Crazed Demon Cave Three Venerables War
events.description: Great Love / Heaven Refining Demon Venerable battles Star Constellation and Giant Sun for the primordial truth of eternal life.
